issues.title: Fix Auth Bypass
issues.description: Users can bypass the MFA validation protocol screen via malicious session storage manipulation steps. Secure fallback tokens must validate signatures correctly.

issues.title: Optimize DB Query
issues.description: The administrative metrics dashboard takes over 4 seconds to fully compile heavy table outputs. Missing index arrays on foreign relational tables must be provisioned.

issues.title: Fix Dark Mode Contrast
issues.description: Secondary typography elements fail baseline readability ratios across muted slate templates. Update specific text hex targets.

issues.title: Websocket Memory Leak
issues.description: Closing workspace tracking panels unexpectedly leaves active streaming handles orphanized in runtime contexts, exhausting core network pipelines.

issues.title: Configure Redis Cache Cluster
issues.description: Set up a highly scalable workspace transaction cache. Eviction schemas must strictly deploy least-recently-used constraints to avoid server drops.

issues.title: Dockerize Dev Environments
issues.description: Construct automated staging configurations to isolate running node engines completely away from underlying machine profiles seamlessly.

issues.title: Audit Stripe Webhook Targets
issues.description: Inbound payload signatures fail secure decryption verifications due to structural header body-parsing bugs inside express routing layers.

issues.title: Optimize NextJS Asset Bundles
issues.description: Convert heavy modular chart visualizations into fully asynchronous components to aggressively slash bundle sizes across lower data bandwidths.
